ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by forward discount, buy the highest-interest-rate portfolio and sell the lowest-interest-rate portfolio, rebalancing monthly.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Currencies against the US dollar; the paper also examines a developed-country sample that includes major currencies.
rules.entry: Sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount; go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
rules.exit: Rebalance portfolios at the end of every month.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average excess returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency portfolios.
